/pulls?state=all&per_page=100.body:
Computation needs a stable portable boundary before native execution can advance without circular ownership. This PR completes the extension-free Phase 1A contract baseline: 20 public types for exact semantic/capability identities, plan/cache identity, bounded opaque program/document/artifact transport, ordered findings/results and coarse compiler/executor ports.

The independently reviewed native ownership/ABI proposal stays explicitly a proposal. No semantic implementation or Conversion/Canonical JSON API/corpus is selected: payloads remain opaque, with no PHP algorithm, canonicalizer, native binding, ConfigProvider, fallback or App adoption. Current App production code/tests remain until the separately gated native cutover. New portable unit/conformance tests live here; native algorithms/lifecycle and App composition tests stay with their owners.

Validation on final head 183226b0b677a62309e271ec9098bb5f8ac05195: [Computation CI passed](https://github.com/kumwe/computation/actions/runs/34115652841). This includes 13 package test groups / 471 assertions, 14 negative ownership/corpus cases, 12 release-parser cases, security audit, strict syntax/PSR-12, maximum PHPStan across source/tests/tooling, complete member/API documentation and manifests, and installation of the real built 45-file ZIP as a fresh no-dev Composer dependency. All 20 public symbols load through its authoritative autoloader. Runtime requires only 64-bit PHP 8.5; there is no hidden ext-ctype requirement. Actual App PackageManifests loader accepts the complete handoff as v2-manifested.

Release safeguards require maintainer protection of main and enabling release immutability before initial merge; the workflow refuses unprotected publication and verifies immutable releases. No repository settings or releases were changed.

Migration MIG-2026-008; change set KUMWE-CS-2026-008; NRM-2026-010. Human merge/release and independent verification of the baseline precede Engine stable; Phase 1B waits for verified baseline/Engine/extension releases. App provisioning must merge before the separate Computation runtime cutover.
